summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives in Las Vegas with a commanding 111-point lead over Max Verstappen, seeking to extend his grip on a championship that Mercedes has already locked down in the constructors' battle. George Russell's pace-setting run in wet practice signals the Silver Arrows remain sharp, though Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc loom as threats on a circuit that rewards precision. With two races remaining after Vegas, Antonelli can move decisively toward the title if he maintains Mercedes' momentum while Verstappen hunts for a breakthrough to challenge the gap.
